answer: Assign weight by a trust random walk seeded only at a vetted honest core, with restart so mass decays with distance. An identity's standing is the stationary probability the walk lands on it. A sybil meadow can mirror endless internal edges, but the walk reaches it only through its handful of genuine inbound links from the core, so total mass absorbed by the whole fake region is bounded by those few real edges, not by how densely the clones wire themselves. Internal umber-dark cliques inflate nothing; splitting into more personas just divides the same fixed mass thinner.
